name: sys_entry
notes: MZ entry of MPC2000.SYS (CS:IP 0000:0010 in the header, loaded at 3000)

name: div32
notes: Push divisor dword then dividend dword; returns DX:AX

name: draw_resource
notes: Push seg, off of an LCD resource stream; reached as PUSH CS + near CALL

name: register_events
notes: Push seg, off of a table of 5-byte entries (key byte + far pointer)

name: int35_note_dispatch
notes: INT 35h BL=0 direct note dispatch path; its IRET is at 3000:1F6E

name: pool_alloc
notes: Push PCM word count as dword; rounds up to 16 words; AX = handle, >=130 = failure

name: draw_unsigned
notes: Push x, y, value dword, digits

name: draw_signed
notes: Push x, y, value dword, width

name: pcm_dma_copy
notes: DMA copy of PCM words: push src dword, dst dword, 0, count

name: voice_overlap_stop
notes: Stops a voice when the same note retriggers

name: voice_stop_now
notes: Immediate voice stop, as used by TRIM; push voice

name: pitch_ratio_table
notes: 481 words; centre 491A:07F8 = 1000h; index = pitch in tenths of a semitone, -240..+240

name: sound_pool
notes: 130 x 10-byte entries: base dword, length dword, next word

name: pad_map_pointer
notes: Far pointer to the effective pad-to-note map
